title: Set your budget
body: Open Budget, tap Edit beside the total and enter your overall limit.

title: Record a payment
body: Open Budget and choose Add expense. Enter the planned and paid amounts.

title: Add or import guests
body: Open Guests to add one person. Contact and CSV import are available after permission.

title: Send an e-card on WhatsApp
body: Choose Invitation, design the card, publish a unique link for each guest and tap WhatsApp beside the recipient.

title: Read RSVP results
body: Open Guests to see Attending, Pending or Not attending status and the confirmed pax total.

title: Use the seating plan
body: Open Seating Plan, add tables and capacity, then assign guests without exceeding a table's limit.

title: QR check-in on the day
body: Open QR Check-in on the team's device and scan the unique QR on the guest invitation. The attendance total updates live.

title: Find and book vendors
body: Filter by category, state, date and price before sending an enquiry.

title: Invite your partner or family
body: From Team, share an invite link or QR and assign their role.

title: Upgrade
body: Open Packages, choose Pro or Premium and complete the store purchase.
